rows.source_table: Abstract (Results), 4th sentence: 'In the presence of the RNA-aptamer reversal agent anivamersen, neither CD62P-expression nor platelet aggregation was attenuated.' (supported by Abstract Conclusion: 'This effect was negated by anivamersen.')
rows.notes: HUMAN IN-VITRO ROW — the second-priority class for this dataset. WHY THIS ROW EXISTS AND THE THREE ON-TARGET ROWS DO NOT (the exclusion line, stated as instructed): pegnivacogin's reductions in ADP-induced CD62P (100% vs 89.79+/-4.04%, p=0.027, n=9), PAC-1 binding (100% vs 83.02+/-4.08%, p=0.010, n=11), LTA aggregation (97.71+/-5.30% vs 66.53+/-9.92%, p=0.013, n=10) and residual aggregation in RADAR patients after 1 mg/kg IV (100% vs 43.21+/-8.23%, p=0.020) are all DECREASES produced BY DESIGN — FIXa inhibition lowers thrombin generation, thrombin is 'a major platelet activator' (the paper's own Background), and the paper's Conclusion frames the result as 'a promising antithrombotic strategy'. That is intended anticoagulant pharmacology, is excluded per the anti-FIXa/anti-vWF rule, and is NOT entered as toxicity in any direction. THE ANIVAMERSEN CONDITION IS DIFFERENT AND IS IN SCOPE: with the aptamer's on-target activity neutralised by its complementary antidote, the oligonucleotides are still present in human whole blood, and the source reports NO platelet-activation signal — i.e. an explicit negative for a TARGET-INDEPENDENT (unintended) oligonucleotide-platelet interaction, which is precisely the hazard this dataset exists to capture for PS-ASOs and aptamers. GRADE 0 per the rubric's in-vitro column ('No activation, aggregation, or binding above vehicle control at tested concentration'). IMPORTANT CAVEAT ON THE GRADE: the abstract phrases this as absence of ATTENUATION ('was not attenuated' / 'negated'), which asserts return to the control level rather than explicitly asserting 'no increase above control'; no increase is reported anywhere in the abstract, and no numbers are printed for this condition, so readout_value is TBD. If full text shows a supra-control CD62P rise under anivamersen this row becomes grade 1. readout_unit follows the abstract's own convention for these readouts (control normalised to 100%); the value itself was not printed. dose_or_conc_value is TBD, not the patients' 1 mg/kg bolus — the abstract gives no in-vitro pegnivacogin (or anivamersen) concentration, and importing the clinical dose would be an invented attribution. Full text inaccessible (paywalled) — see extraction_notes.

rows.notes: HUMAN IN-VITRO ROW, light transmission aggregometry. Same exclusion line and same grade-0 rationale as the paired CD62P row: pegnivacogin's own aggregation-lowering effect is on-target antithrombotic pharmacology and is excluded; the anivamersen-reversed condition is an explicit negative for an UNINTENDED, target-independent platelet effect of the oligonucleotide and is in scope at grade 0. TWO EXPLICIT UNCERTAINTIES A CONSUMER MUST SEE. (1) STUDY-TYPE AMBIGUITY: study_type=in_vitro is assigned because the sentence sits inside the abstract's in-vitro block, immediately after the healthy-volunteer whole-blood results and before 'In patients with ACS...', and because CD62P (its clause-mate) was measured ONLY in vitro. However, the abstract's Methods also state that the RADAR patient aggregometry 'featur[ed] the intravenous administration of pegnivacogin as well as reversal by anivamersen', so an aggregation-under-anivamersen measurement could equally exist in the ex-vivo patient arm. Without full text the locus cannot be resolved; if it is in fact the patient arm this row becomes study_type=ex_vivo/clinical, species still human. It is NOT split into two rows, because that would manufacture an observation the source reports once. (2) SYSTEM_MODEL: recorded as human_whole_blood because that is what the Methods sentence says was incubated ('Whole blood samples from healthy volunteers were incubated in vitro'); light transmission aggregometry conventionally requires platelet-rich plasma prepared from those samples, but the abstract never says PRP, so human_PRP is NOT asserted. dose_or_conc_value TBD — no in-vitro concentration is printed.
